name: coverage
//: The repo-level coverage gate: clears the shared profile directory before the instrumented test runs, then merges every coverage:profiles project's profiles and enforces the 95% line floor over the llmlint crate's sources (src/), once (coverage.sh). It depends on exactly what can move that number: the projects whose tests write profiles, and its own driver.

coverage.//: Uncached: the profiles it merges come from uncached test runs, so a replay could report on a set that no longer exists.

test.//: The driver against a scratch Cargo workspace under the real cargo-llvm-cov: profiles combine across crates, the floor fails below 95%, and bad input is a usage error.
